verses.en: O that thou wert as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.
verses.pt: Ah! quem me dera que foras como meu irmão, que mamou os seios de minha mãe! quando eu te encontrasse lá fora, eu te beijaria; e não me desprezariam!
verses.en_web: Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you; yes, and no one would despise me.
verses.en_bbe: Oh that you were my brother, who took milk from my mother's breasts! When I came to you in the street, I would give you kisses; yes, I would not be looked down on.

verses.en: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother’s house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.
verses.pt: Eu te levaria e te introduziria na casa de minha mãe, e tu me instruirias; eu te daria a beber vinho aromático, o mosto das minhas romãs.
verses.en_web: I would lead you, bringing you into my mother’s house, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.
verses.en_bbe: I would take you by the hand into my mother's house, and she would be my teacher. I would give you drink of spiced wine, drink of the pomegranate.

verses.en: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.
verses.pt: A sua mão esquerda estaria debaixo da minha cabeça, e a sua direita me abraçaria.
verses.en_web: His left hand would be under my head. His right hand would embrace me.
verses.en_bbe: His left hand would be under my head, and his right hand about me.

verses.en: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.
verses.pt: Conjuro-vos, ó filhas de Jerusalém, que não acordeis nem desperteis o amor, até que ele o queira.
verses.en_web: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
verses.en_bbe: I say to you, O daughters of Jerusalem, do not let love be moved till it is ready.

verses.en: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee.
verses.pt: Quem é esta que sobe do deserto, e vem encostada ao seu amado? Debaixo da macieira te despertei; ali esteve tua mãe com dores; ali esteve com dores aquela que te deu à luz.
verses.en_web: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Under the apple tree I aroused you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.
verses.en_bbe: Who is this, who comes up from the waste places, resting on her loved one? It was I who made you awake under the apple-tree, where your mother gave you birth; there she was in pain at your birth.

verses.en: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.
verses.pt: Põe-me como selo sobre o teu coração, como selo sobre o teu braço; porque o amor é forte como a morte; o ciúme é cruel como o Seol; a sua chama é chama de fogo, verdadeira labareda do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Put me as a sign on your heart, as a sign on your arm; love is strong as death, and wrath bitter as the underworld: its coals are coals of fire; violent are its flames.

verses.en: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
verses.pt: As muitas águas não podem apagar o amor, nem os rios afogá- lo. Se alguém oferecesse todos os bens de sua casa pelo amor, seria de todo desprezado.
verses.en_web: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.
verses.en_bbe: Much water may not put out love, or the deep waters overcome it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would be judged a price not great enough.

verses.en: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
verses.pt: Temos uma irmã pequena, que ainda não tem seios; que faremos por nossa irmã, no dia em que ela for pedida em casamento?
verses.en_web: We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?
verses.en_bbe: We have a young sister, and she has no breasts; what are we to do for our sister in the day when she is given to a man?

verses.en: If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.
verses.pt: Se ela for um muro, edificaremos sobre ela uma torrezinha de prata; e, se ela for uma porta, cercá-la-emos com tábuas de cedro.
verses.en_web: If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. if she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar.
verses.en_bbe: If she is a wall, we will make on her a strong base of silver; and if she is a door, we will let her be shut up with cedar-wood.

verses.en: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
verses.pt: Eu era um muro, e os meus seios eram como as suas torres; então eu era aos seus olhos como aquela que acha paz.
verses.en_web: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.
verses.en_bbe: I am a wall, and my breasts are like towers; then was I in his eyes as one to whom good chance had come.

verses.en: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.
verses.pt: Teve Salomão uma vinha em Baal-Hamom; arrendou essa vinha a uns guardas; e cada um lhe devia trazer pelo seu fruto mil peças de prata.
verses.en_web: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.
verses.en_bbe: Solomon had a vine-garden at Baal-hamon; he let out the vine-garden to keepers; every one had to give a thousand bits of silver for its fruit.

verses.en: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
verses.pt: A minha vinha que me pertence está diante de mim; tu, ó Salomão, terás as mil peças de prata, e os que guardam o fruto terão duzentas.
verses.en_web: My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon; two hundred for those who tend its fruit.
verses.en_bbe: My vine-garden, which is mine, is before me: you, O Solomon, will have the thousand, and those who keep the fruit of them two hundred.

verses.en: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it.
verses.pt: ç tu, que habitas nos jardins, os companheiros estão atentos para ouvir a tua voz; faze-me, pois, também ouvi-la:
verses.en_web: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice!
verses.en_bbe: You who have your resting-place in the gardens, the friends give ear to your voice; make me give ear to it.

verses.en: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
verses.pt: Vem depressa, amado meu, e faze-te semelhante ao gamo ou ao filho da gazela sobre os montes dos aromas.
verses.en_web: Come away, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices!
verses.en_bbe: Come quickly, my loved one, and be like a roe on the mountains of spice.
